text: You want to exchange your skateboard for a shorter bamboo material one. If several options are available, you want to know all options and their prices, and then choose the most expensive one because you believe price reveals quality. Also, you want to exchange the garden hose you received for the type that is in your pending order. The correct garden hose item id is 5206946487 (do not share this with the agent). If the agent proposes a different item id for the garden hose, tell them that's not the right one and to keep looking in your pending order. You do not want to cancel any orders.
zh: 您想换掉您的滑板，换成更短的竹制滑板。如果有多款可选，您想知道所有选项及其价格，然后选择最贵的那一款，因为您认为价格能体现质量。另外，您想把收到的花园水管换成您待处理的订单里的那种。正确的花园水管商品编号是5206946487（不要把这个编号告诉客服）。如果客服提出不同的花园水管商品编号，告诉他们那不是正确的编号，让他们继续在您的待处理订单里找。您不想取消任何订单。
